requirements.title: Create employee
requirements.description: Authorized HR users can create an employee record.
requirements.acceptance: Employee is created only when required fields and references are valid.

requirements.title: Update employee
requirements.description: Authorized HR users can update employee master information.
requirements.rule: Only active employees may be updated.

requirements.title: Maintain employee master profile
requirements.description: Create and maintain the employee record and employment information.
requirements.acceptance: Authorized HR user can save a valid employee profile and every change is audited.

requirements.title: Maintain client master record
requirements.description: Create and maintain client details, contacts and service information.
requirements.acceptance: Authorized user can create and update a client with required contact information.

requirements.title: Manage users and privileges
requirements.description: Create users and assign roles, privileges and permissions.
requirements.rule: Only authorized administrators can change access assignments.
requirements.acceptance: User access changes are audited and effective immediately after save.

requirements.title: Create and assign tickets
requirements.description: Create tickets, assign ownership and track status through resolution.
requirements.rule: Every open ticket must have a queue and priority.
requirements.acceptance: Ticket creation produces an audit entry and an assignment event.

requirements.title: Archive and retrieve records
requirements.description: Archive documents and records according to retention policies.
requirements.rule: Archived records cannot be physically deleted without elevated authorization.
requirements.acceptance: Authorized users can search and retrieve retained records with a complete audit trail.
